_note: Tiles, seconds, coins. One tile is about a metre. Run npm test and node tools/sim.js after changing anything (the helper should reach the cave in roughly 20-35 minutes and find most of the museum within about 45).

shaft._note: The old shaft at the left of the village: ladders down to a short gallery. Each cage station extends it.

stations._note: One cage station per old mine, bought at the workshop once you have been that deep. speed: tiles a second in the cage. sell: share of the weighbridge price paid at a station.

_jackpots: Ores with a count (not a chance) are jackpots: that many single tiles in their layer.

finds._note: Museum pieces, three per old mine, each hidden in a small old chamber or timbered gallery off the straight-down lines. glint: tiles at which the lamp catches it. fee: the finder's fee per layer, top to bottom. away: pockets keep at least this many tiles from the start column and the old shaft.

badAir._note: Gas pockets: clusters of size[0]-size[1] tiles in the rock, seeded at seed per tile. warn: tiles at which the lamp gutters and it hisses (each lamp level adds warnPerLamp: a better lamp warns earlier). Dug into, the whole pocket lets go: the gas drifts through open tiles (drift: seconds per tile) up to reach + reachPer per extra pocket tile, and lingers secs + secsPer per extra tile. Where air can move (two separate ways out to the surface or the old shaft), it drains vent times faster. Standing in it drains dps strength a second and burns the lamp light times faster. Dynamite will not light within fizzle tiles of bad air.

loose._note: Loose rock: with nothing under it, it trickles dust and creaks for warn seconds, then falls.

water._note: Water pockets: clusters of size[0]-size[1] tiles, seeded at seed per tile, from the copper layer down. warn: tiles at which you hear dripping. Dug into, the whole pocket lets go volume tiles of water per pocket tile, at rate a second, running downhill through open tiles and seeping away slowly. Water deeper than slowAt slows you; deeper than deep, the light burns drain times faster. Over drown (half the tile) your head is under: breath (seconds) runs down, then strength drains at dps a second (a helmet doesn't help you breathe, so gear doesn't soften it); out of it, breath comes back at once.

items._note: Things for the belt, bought at the workshop. max: how many the belt holds.

score._note: Score = all the money earned over the career (ore and finder's fees, the cave piece too) + museum per piece on the shelves + cave for reaching the cave + escape for climbing out ahead of the water.

eras._note: When each tool level was used, shown in the workshop. Only where the record is clear; others stay out.

escape._note: The finale. Taking the piece in the cave wakes the old workings: after grace seconds of rumbling, water rises from the cave floor at rise tiles a second, quickening by accel each second up to max, and stops at row top. You are safe once your feet are above top. haul: seconds the cage takes to bring you up at the end. fee: the finder's fee for the piece. Caught by the water (breath then strength gone), the cage lifts you out: nothing is lost, but there is no escape bonus.
